items.title: What Iran says is in the Donald Trump deal and the item 'removed from the agenda'
items.description: Iran agreeing to a ceasefire deal with the United States tells us Tehran likely had something to gain from signing on. This is what Iran is promoting as the 14-point deal.

items.title: Why the market thinks Michele Bullock is bluffing on rate hikes
items.description: Michele Bullock made it abundantly clear that the RBA was not ruling out further interest rate rises, but the market appears to be unswayed by the tough talk.

items.title: Tim Wilson holds undisclosed shares in climate advisory firm through family trust
items.description: The shadow treasurer's investment trust holds 15,000 shares in a small company called Gondwana Carbon, which helps developers to acquire land, develop carbon abatement projects, earn carbon credits and then trade them.

items.title: Jacinta Allan refuses to admit cost of CFMEU corruption to taxpayers
items.description: Embattled Victorian Premier Jacinta Allan has refused to answer repeated questions over how much CFMEU corruption has cost taxpayers in the state, a scandal that has put the government and her leadership under threat.

items.title: Live: Mbappe scores after Aussie ref's 'nonsensical' call to deny France penalty
items.description: Day six at the World Cup features a number of superstar strikers, beginning with a blockbuster between Kylian Mbappe's France and Senegal at New York New Jersey Stadium. Follow live.

items.title: The ultimate 'infidel' killed Khamenei. These women want 'revenge' on Trump
items.description: As we journey into the heart of Iran, we meet the women who support the clerics and want revenge on the man who killed Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

items.title: Dealing with NDIS leading to anxiety and suicidal ideation among participants
items.description: Participants say they are "exhausted" and "overwhelmed" by trying to navigate the complex and ever-changing NDIS system.

items.title: Gout runs a stunning third as Lyles breaks world record
items.description: Rising Australian superstar Gout Gout pushes American champion Noah Lyles all the way in their first race against each other.

items.title: El Niño declared by BOM and it could become the strongest on record
items.description: El Niño is a state which can linger for up to 12 months and disrupt weather patterns across the globe, with Australia especially prone.

items.title: Russian artist who satirised Putin shot dead in Poland
items.description: Two Belarusian nationals are arrested in connection with the killing, authorities say.

items.title: UK investigates reports Russian ship fired at yacht in English Channel
items.description: Russia's defence ministry said it fired the warning shots to divert the yacht that approached on a dangerous course in the English Channel.

items.title: 'It's all too hard': Fuel shock pushes regional businesses to the brink
items.description: Small-town coffee shops and long-established businesses are at risk of closing despite a ceasefire in the Middle East easing the global oil price. Regional businesses say fuel relief measures need to be extended because the damage done from the fuel shock is far from over.

items.title: Lorne residents hope invention will stop cockatoos from trashing town
items.description: Residents of the scenic Great Ocean Road are at their wits' end after the increasingly intelligent birds learnt how to lift the lids of wheelie bins, spreading rubbish through the scenic town.

items.title: Pensioner finds cheaper life in Thailand after rent squeeze
items.description: Peter Stevenson says moving to Thailand has allowed him to live more comfortably on his Australian Age Pension after struggling to cover rent and essentials in regional Victoria.

items.title: 'Life-changing' school for autistic children saved from 'chopping block'
items.description: The Queensland government says The Sycamore School, based in the Redlands, was "on the chopping block".

items.title: State of Origin quiz: Tackle our More or Less challenge ahead of Game II
items.description: Today's ABC More or Less quiz challenges you to go deep into AFL territory and come away with the win. Mouthguards in, let's go.

items.title: Looking for something to play? Here are the best games of 2026 so far
items.description: From cosy builders to hectic shooters and all the way through to nostalgic adventures, there are lots of gems to enjoy on your favourite game console so far this year.

items.title: Ann Patchett on why stalkers want her to read their novels
items.description: The bestselling author of books including Bel Canto, Tom Lake and her latest, Whistler, is determined to see the good in everyone.

items.title: Fatal US B-52 bomber crash happened at more than 1,500m per minute
items.description: A B-52 bomber aircraft that crashed at a US Air Force base in California, killing eight people aboard, made a sharp right and then nearly completed a 180-degree turn before plunging to the ground.

items.title: Time for Russia to make a deal to end Ukraine war, Trump says
items.description: Donald Trump says Moscow should "make a deal" to end the war with Ukraine as G7 leaders have agreed to intensify pressure on Russia.

items.title: FBI says plot to attack White House UFC event with drones thwarted
items.description: US media says five people are in custody in connection with the plot, that involved flying explosive-laden drones towards buildings near last weekend's White House UFC match.

items.title: Visitors to Kunanyi/Mt Wellington should pay, report finds

items.title: Ex-Hawke minister-turned Catholic priest farewelled in Hobart
items.description: Michael Tate — an academic, politician, diplomat and Catholic priest — has been remembered as a generous man whose life was one of "warmth and service to others".

items.title: Two men arrested by Dezi Freeman investigators
items.description: Police executed seven warrants at properties across Victoria and New South Wales this morning.
